scientific_integrity: A complete argument for upper bounds and constructions is supplied. The finite exception at length eight and the perfect length-nine partition have executable checks and compact finite certificates. External review and independent audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two nonoverlapping deletion bursts of two contiguous symbols each; binary length five through nine only. No claim of a general formula, uniqueness of the optimal code, or optimality of constructions over other alphabets. The lengths five and six are boundary context; the length-six cardinality is included in previously published results.
title: Exact short-block binary two-burst deletion codes and a perfect length-nine construction
